title: Over 440,000 Exploit Attempts Target Super Forms and Elementor Pro RCE Flaws
summary: Threat actors are exploiting two critical security flaws in WordPress plugins Super Forms and Elementor Pro, according to findings from Wordfence.

title: Plex Urges Immediate Updates After Patching Multiple Undisclosed Security Flaws
summary: Plex is urging users to update their instances to the latest version following the release of an update that patches multiple security flaws.
card_summary: Plex is urging users to update their instances to the latest version following the release of an update that patches multiple security flaws.
email_summary: Plex is urging users to update their instances to the latest version following the release of an update that patches multiple security flaws. The fixes are available in Plex Media Server 1.43.3 and Plex Desktop 1.115.0.

title: Google Releases Chrome Update to Patch Actively Exploited V8 Zero-Day
